verses.text: A Song of the Ascents. To YHWH, in the distress for me, I cried out, and He answered me.

segments.text: A Song of the Ascents. To YHWH, in the distress for me, I cried out, and He answered me.

verses.text: O YHWH, deliver my soul from a lip of falsehood, from a tongue of deceit!

segments.text: O YHWH, deliver my soul from a lip of falsehood, from a tongue of deceit!

verses.text: What will He give to you, or what will He add to you, O tongue of deceit?

segments.text: What will He give to you, or what will He add to you, O tongue of deceit?

verses.text: The sharpened arrows of a mighty one, with the burning coals of broom trees!

segments.text: The sharpened arrows of a mighty one, with the burning coals of broom trees!

verses.text: Woe to me for I have sojourned [in] Mesech; I have dwelt among the tents of Kedar!

segments.text: Woe to me for I have sojourned [in] Mesech; I have dwelt among the tents of Kedar!

verses.text: Too much has dwelt my soul with the one hating peace!

segments.text: Too much has dwelt my soul with the one hating peace!

verses.text: I [am] peace, and when I speak, they [are] for war.

segments.text: I [am] peace, and when I speak, they [are] for war.
